summary: THE PREMISE FAILS, and that is the deliverable. The ask says animefillerguide's row 95 contradicts our stored canon on row 95. It does not contradict it, because it is not the same episode: AFG's rurouni-kenshin page is the 1996 TV series ONLY, it holds 95 rows, and its row 95 is '(33). End of Wanderings *Filler / N/A' — the TV series' own 95th and final instalment. OUR row 95 is 'The Man of the Slashing Sword', 1999-02-20, act 1 of the Tsuioku-hen (Trust & Betrayal) OVA, numbered after a 94-episode TV run by the stored I39 / T29 / N1 rulings. The T4 strong-tier flag index-joined two different row spaces (R20: join on title or date, never index). Read by TITLE the two tables agree everywhere they overlap: AFG 91 'The Magic of Feng Shui', 92 'Tokyo Under Martial Law', 93 'The Enemy Awaits in Senjogahara', 94 'The Elegy of Wind and Water' are our 91-94 exactly, all four filler on both labels; AFG simply carries one more TV row than we do and carries no OVA rows at all. animefillerlist, by contrast, shares OUR space: its 100-row page skips the unaired TV episode and numbers the OVAs 95-100 ('95 The Man of the Slashing Sword / Manga Canon / 1999-02-20' ... '100 After So Many Years Have Lapsed, Part 2 / Filler / 2002-03-20'), row for row our stored titles, dates and types. So the context's 'AFL: canon' on row 95 is a true statement about OUR row and AFG's 'filler' is a true statement about a row we do not have. STORED TYPE CONFIRMED. Row 95 is canon: en-Wikipedia's Trust & Betrayal article calls the OVA 'based on the Rurouni Kenshin manga series by Nobuhiro Watsuki, and a prequel to its 1996 TV series'; AFL types it Manga Canon; the stored batch-17 anchor (END 167, START 165, {165-167}) and its divergence / graft annotations stand unchanged, and the P24 record already corrected the old 'pilot one-shots' misidentification. No type_correction, no anchor change, and no anchor_hostile entry is owed because the row already carries a stored anchor. THE REAL FINDING IS STRUCTURAL: the catalog is MISSING the 1996 TV series' 95th episode, and three independent sources say it exists. ja-Wikipedia's るろうに剣心 (アニメ) episode table ends '9月8日 || 94 || 風と水の挽歌・今ここに死力尽くす！' and then '未放送 特別編 || 95 || 流浪の最果て・緋と瑠璃の絆は潮騒の中に', with the prose '本作品は第94話まで放送されたが、放送されなかった第95話が存在し、終了後の1998年12月にソフト化して発売された' and the release entries '（TV）未放映秘蔵ビデオ 流浪の最果て・緋と瑠璃の絆は潮騒の中に' on VHS SVWV-1302 1998-12-02, LD SVWL-1302 1998-12-02 and DVD SVWB-1302 1999-02-20. ja-Wikipedia's main るろうに剣心 article says 全95話. en-Wikipedia's List of Rurouni Kenshin (1996 TV series) episodes says 'There were 95 episodes in the Rurouni Kenshin's TV series' and 'The final episode did not air in Japan, but was a bonus episode for the VHS and DVD releases'. AFG's table carries it as row 95 'End of Wanderings' (= 流浪の最果て) and types it Filler. AniList 45 counts 94 because it counts BROADCAST episodes, which is why our component reads 1-94 and why AFL's page omits it too. I am NOT proposing a repair: inserting the row would shift the six OVA rows 95-100 -> 96-101 and re-open the I39 / T29 / N1 rulings that placed them, which is Sean's call, not a research verdict's. It is filed as a structure finding and a flag with the full identity (number, both titles, the unaired status, the three release dates), and it comes with the DBZ-Kai caution: the episode never aired in Japan, so its honest air_date is NULL (G53), not the VHS or DVD date.

structure.notes: PREMISE CORRECTION + STORED TYPE CONFIRMED, and no row moves. (1) THE FLAG IS AN INDEX JOIN (R20). animefillerguide's rurouni-kenshin page covers the 1996 TV series only and holds 95 data rows, split by season headers with a second '(NN)' season-relative column; the third block starts at '63. (01). The Legend of the Fireflies *Filler' and ends at '95. (33). End of Wanderings *Filler'. Every row from 63 to 95 is red '*Filler / N/A'. Matched by TITLE against our rows: AFG 88-94 = our 88-94 ('The Two Guides', 'To My Angel Misao', 'Feng Shui Surprise Attack!', 'The Magic of Feng Shui', 'Tokyo Under Martial Law', 'The Enemy Awaits in Senjogahara', 'The Elegy of Wind and Water'), all filler on both sides and all matching ja-WP's 88-94 by kanji and date. AFG's row 95 has NO counterpart in our table — it is the unaired TV finale 「流浪の最果て・緋と瑠璃の絆は潮騒の中に」 — while OUR row 95 is Tsuioku-hen act 1 「斬る男」 / 'The Man of the Slashing Sword', 1999-02-20, which AFG's page does not contain at all. So the stored/AFG 'canon/filler' pair is a comparison of two different episodes; there is nothing to reconcile and no source lied about a type. (2) OUR ROW SPACE IS AFL'S. animefillerlist's page holds 100 rows and matches our stored titles, dates and types exactly across 91-100, including the OVA block (95-98 Manga Canon, 99-100 Filler); it too omits the unaired TV episode. (3) THE TYPE IS CONFIRMED, from sources beyond both labels: en-Wikipedia's Rurouni Kenshin: Trust & Betrayal article ('a Japanese original video animation (OVA) series, based on the Rurouni Kenshin manga series by Nobuhiro Watsuki, and a prequel to its 1996 TV series'), whose plot section opens on exactly the material our stored graft{95} annotation records (the bandit raid, Hiko taking Shinta in, the years of training); and ja-Wikipedia's 追憶編 section describing it as 緋村剣心が"人斬り抜刀斎"になるまでの経緯 in four acts. The stored batch-17 anchor (END 167, START 165, {165-167}) and the stored divergence{165-167} and graft{95} annotations are untouched, as is the T29 ova format ruling and the P24 correction of the old 'pilot one-shots' misidentification. (4) CHAPTER SPACE: unchanged; the OVA block sits in the mainline Act numbering (165-179), inside the 259-act / 28-volume space, and our stored v19 = 159-167 agrees with END 167 sitting in vol 19. (5) G55 NAMESAKE CHECK, run as the ask requires: none of the pages used is the 2023 remake's. en-WP's 'List of Rurouni Kenshin episodes' REDIRECTS to 'List of Rurouni Kenshin (1996 TV series) episodes' and that is the page read; ja-WP's るろうに剣心 -明治剣客浪漫譚- (アニメ) covers both the 1996 and 2023 versions in one article and its 1996 episode table was identified by its Fuji TV air dates (1996-01-10 to 1998-09-08) before any row was used; AFG's and AFL's pages are the 1996 series by their dates. No 2023 row entered this verdict.
structure.coverage_set_checked: ep 62 -> END 151 (Kyoto arc end, stored) with continue 165/parity; eps 63-94 = the anime-original TV blocks, filler; ep 95 -> END 167, START 165, {165-167} (stored, unchanged); ep 96 -> 170 [168]; ep 97 -> 174 [172]; ep 98 -> END 179 [175] with the post-series continue at 152. The missing unaired TV episode 95 sits between our rows 94 and 95 in broadcast identity but adapts nothing (AFG types it filler; ja-WP places it inside the anime-original 風水編 tail), so its absence strands no chapter and its insertion would add no anchor.

flags_for_sean: STRUCTURE, not a repair — the catalog is missing the 1996 TV series' 95th episode, and I am filing the identity rather than proposing the insertion because inserting it renumbers the six OVA rows (95-100 -> 96-101) and re-opens I39 / T29 / N1. THE ROW: 1996 TV series, episode 95, 「流浪の最果て・緋と瑠璃の絆は潮騒の中に」, AFG's English title 'End of Wanderings', storyboard/direction Kazuhiro Furuhashi, animation director Tsunaki Aki. STATUS: 未放送 (never broadcast). RELEASES: VHS SVWV-1302 and LD SVWL-1302 on 1998-12-02, DVD SVWB-1302 on 1999-02-20, all as 『未放映秘蔵ビデオ 流浪の最果て・緋と瑠璃の絆は潮騒の中に』. TYPE: filler (AFG; it sits inside the anime-original Feng Shui tail, and the manga was in the Jinchu arc at the time). AIR DATE: the honest value is NULL under G53 — this is the DBZ-Kai Final-Chapters shape (an episode with no Japanese broadcast), so a VHS or DVD date must not be written into air_date as if it were a broadcast. SOURCES: ja-WP るろうに剣心 -明治剣客浪漫譚- (アニメ) episode table and prose ('本作品は第94話まで放送されたが、放送されなかった第95話が存在し'), ja-WP るろうに剣心 ('全95話'), en-WP List of Rurouni Kenshin (1996 TV series) episodes ('There were 95 episodes ... The final episode did not air in Japan, but was a bonus episode for the VHS and DVD releases'), and AFG's 95-row table. AniList 45 says 94 because it counts broadcast episodes; AFL omits it for the same reason, which is why our row space has never noticed the gap.

THE FLAG ITSELF IS THE LESSON: a T4 strong-tier contradiction can be manufactured by a ROW-COUNT difference between AFG and our space rather than by a typing disagreement. AFG's page here is TV-only with 95 rows; ours is TV-plus-OVA with 100. Any series where AFG's row count differs from ours should have the target row re-identified by TITLE before the contradiction is believed — on this one the two labels never disagreed about any episode at all.

OUT OF SCOPE but a real side_source candidate, found in ja-WP's anime article while checking the episode table: '京都編の完結時点では ... アニメ版オリジナルストーリーが展開され（ただし、第79話 - 第82話はノベルズ版が原作）るも風水編で終了となった' — episodes 79-82's stated source is the NOVELS version. Our rows 79-82 are stored filler by Sean's 2026-08-24 T6 ruling (correct against the manga, T25), and the wave-2 protocol's own line is that a novelization is side_source on a filler row unless adopted. Which novel is not settled by that sentence: ja-WP separately records 『るろうに剣心 -明治剣客浪漫譚- 島原編』 (Shueisha JUMP j BOOKS, 1999-02, ISBN 4-08-703077-6, credited Watsuki / Aki Ryou / Muroi Fumie), but that one novelizes the ANIME-ORIGINAL Shimabara arc (eps 67-76) after the fact and so runs the wrong way. Eps 79-82 are the Katsu Kaishu / Beniaoi block, so a different book is implied. Worth one narrow research row: if a licensed novel really is their source, the four rows want side_source annotations; if the novel came after, they want nothing and ja-WP's parenthesis is wrong.
